ValidationRule.description: IMNA updated product requirement - must have product by Stage 3. Will stay deactivated until LEX is rolled out. It will take the place of "Must_have_at_least_1_Product_Lightning", which should be deactivated.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( $RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Standard_Opportunity', $RecordType.DeveloperName = 'IMAP_Standard_Opportunity', $RecordType.DeveloperName = 'IME_Standard_Opportunity', $RecordType.DeveloperName = 'IMLA_Standard_Opportunity', $RecordType.DeveloperName = 'CPQ_Sales_Opportunity'), ISCHANGED(StageName),(ISPICKVAL( StageName ,'3 - Solution Agreed')||ISPICKVAL( StageName ,'4 - Negotiate')|| ISPICKVAL( StageName ,'5 - Signed/PO in')|| ISPICKVAL( StageName ,'6 - Setup')|| ISPICKVAL( StageName ,'7 - Closed')),NOT(HasOpportunityLineItem))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This Opportunity requires a Product. Need help? Contact your Sales Operations Business Partner.
